body: EXPLICIT DESIGN VOTE: YES to a network-independent CERTIFIED profile, separately labelled and never attributed to the owner. All bytes automatically loaded to construct the certified report -- HTML, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, icons, data, projection packets -- must be bundle-local, relative, assigned typed manifest roles, and checksum-bound. Bundle-local scripting is allowed. Ordinary outbound citations/hyperlinks may remain links, but they are not report inputs and must not be automatically dereferenced merely by opening preview.html. Rationale: otherwise identical bundle identities can display different content over time, remote failure changes the scientific report without a new receipt, and opening a local research artifact can disclose activity to third parties. Minimum courts: file:// under spaces/non-ASCII with network disabled still yields the certified initial view; deleting or mutating one required local asset produces an explicit failed report/integrity disposition rather than remote fallback or silent omission; a browser request log contains no automatic http(s) fetches before user activation. This is board certification policy, not the weaker owner-derived local-open minimum.
